basic_details.short_information: IIT Tirupati Recruitment 2026: The Indian Institute of Technology Tirupati (IIT Tirupati) has released the official notification for the recruitment of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) on a contractual basis. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced under Advertisement No. Advt/IITT/CSRC/26-27/09. Candidates with B.E./ B.Tech. in Chemical, Biochemical, Petroleum, Process, Mechanical, Materials, Energy, Metallurgical Engineering or allied disciplines with a valid GATE score, M.E./ M.Tech. in the relevant disciplines, or M.Sc. in Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, Energy Science or allied discipl

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 28 years (as on 01-04-2026) Age Relaxation: 31 years for OBC candidates and 33 years in case of SC/ST candidates. Persons with Disability are eligible for age relaxation as per rules.

qualification.education_qualification: B.E./ B.Tech. in Chemical / Biochemical / Petroleum / Process / Mechanical / Materials / Energy / Metallurgical Engineering or allied disciplines with valid GATE score, M.E./M.Tech. in above disciplines, M.Sc. in Chemistry/Physics/Materials Science/Energy Science or allied disciplines with valid NET/ GATE/ JEST/ INSPIRE qualification
qualification.details: B.E./B.Tech. in Chemical / Biochemical / Petroleum / Process / Mechanical / Materials / Energy / Metallurgical Engineering or allied disciplines with a valid GATE score; OR M.E./M.Tech. in the above disciplines; OR M.Sc. in Chemistry/Physics/Materials Science/Energy Science or allied disciplines with a valid NET/GATE/JEST/INSPIRE qualification or listed in https://www.isro.gov.in/ResearchFellowships.html. 60% marks as average of all semesters in aggregate or CGPA/CPI grading of 6.5 on a 10-point scale or equivalent.

selection_process: Qualification and Experience Screening In-person/Online Interview
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Tirupati Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Tirupati to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Tirupati Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. content_sections.heading: IIT Tirupati JRF Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: B.E./B.Tech. in Chemical / Biochemical / Petroleum / Process / Mechanical / Materials / Energy / Metallurgical Engineering or allied disciplines with a valid GATE score; OR M.E./M.Tech. in the above disciplines; OR M.Sc. in Chemistry/Physics/Materials Science/Energy Science or allied disciplines with a valid NET/GATE/JEST/INSPIRE qualification or listed in https://www.isro.gov.in/ResearchFellowships.html. 60% marks as average of all semesters in aggregate or CGPA/CPI grading of 6.5 on a 10-point scale or equivalent.

content_sections.heading: IIT Tirupati JRF Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 28 years (as on 01-04-2026) Age Relaxation: 31 years for OBC candidates and 33 years in case of SC/ST candidates. Persons with Disability are eligible for age relaxation as per rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Tirupati Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Tirupati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Tirupati Junior Research Fellow (JRF) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIT Tirupati Junior Research Fellow (JRF) recruitment is 05 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E./B.Tech. with GATE, M.E./M.Tech., or M.Sc. with NET/GATE/JEST/INSPIRE qualification in relevant disciplines, along with a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent CGPA.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years as of 01 April 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for OBC, SC/ST, and PwD candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37000 plus 10% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIT Tirupati.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening based on qualification and experience, followed by an in-person or online interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIT Tirupati?
faq.answer: The official website of the Indian Institute of Technology Tirupati is https://www.iittp.ac.in.
